questions.question: The cost price of a fan is Rs. 4,400. A merchant wants to make a 24% profit by selling it. At the time of sale, merchant declares a discount of 12% on the marked price. Find the marked price.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹4,400

Profit Percentage = 24%

Discount Percentage = 12%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (1 + Profit Percentage/100)

Marked Price (MP) = SP / (1 - Discount Percentage/100)

**Calculation:**

SP = 4400 × (1 + 24/100)

⇒ SP = 4400 × 1.24

⇒ SP = 5456

MP = 5456 / (1 - 12/100)

⇒ MP = 5456 / 0.88

⇒ MP = 6200

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

Study the following graph and answer the question that follows.

The following bar graph shows the percentage profit earned by two companies A and B over the given years. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8490d1755f784a3b19b8c2d34f047afcad76b7cb4aadc23676192206c1854a49.png] 

The incomes of two companies A and B in 2006 were in the ratio 3 : 4, respectively. What was the respective ratio of their expenditures in 2006?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Incomes of companies A and B in 2006 are in the ratio 3:4

Profit percentage for Company A in 2006 = 65%

Profit percentage for Company B in 2006 = 50%

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Income - Expenditure) / Expenditure × 100

**Calculations:**

Let the incomes of Company A and Company B be 3x and 4x respectively.

**Step 1: For Company A**

65 = (3x - Expenditure of A) / Expenditure of A × 100

⇒ 0.65 × Expenditure of A = 3x - Expenditure of A

⇒ 1.65 × Expenditure of A = 3x

⇒ Expenditure of A = 3x / 1.65

**Step 2: For Company B**

50 = (4x - Expenditure of B) / Expenditure of B × 100

⇒ 0.50 × Expenditure of B = 4x - Expenditure of B

⇒ 1.50 × Expenditure of B = 4x

⇒ Expenditure of B = 4x / 1.50

**Step 3: Ratio of Expenditures**

Ratio = (3x / 1.65) : (4x / 1.50)

⇒ Ratio = (3 × 1.50) : (4 × 1.65)

⇒ Ratio = 4.5 : 6.6

⇒ Ratio = 15 : 22

**∴ The ratio of expenditures of Company A and Company B in 2006 is 15:22.**

questions.question: The surface area of a spherical ball is 1386 cm² . What will be its volume?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The surface area of a spherical ball is 1386 cm².

**Formula used:**

Surface Area of Sphere, S = 4πr²

Volume of Sphere, V = (4/3)πr³

**Calculation:**

1386 = 4πr²

⇒ r² = 1386 / (4π)

⇒ r² = 1386 / (4 × 3.14)

⇒ r² ≈ 110.49

⇒ r ≈ √110.49

⇒ r ≈ 10.51 cm

Now, Volume, V = (4/3)πr³

⇒ V = (4/3) × 3.14 × (10.51)³

⇒ V ≈ (4/3) × 3.14 × 1159.39

⇒ V ≈ 4851 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**

questions.question: Two circles of radii 3 units and r units, respectively, have a 6 units distance between their centers. If the length of the direct common tangent is sqrt35 units, then the value of r is ________ units.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the first circle = 3 units

Radius of the second circle = r units

Distance between centers = 6 units

Length of the direct common tangent = √35 units

**Formula used:**

Length of direct common tangent = √(d² - (r₁ - r₂)²)

**Calculation:**

√35 = √(6² - (3 - r)²)

⇒ 35 = 36 - (3 - r)²

⇒ (3 - r)2 = 36 - 35 = 1

⇒ 3 - r = ±1

⇒ r = 3 + 1 = 4 units OR

⇒ r = 3 - 1 = 2 units

So, the circle radius can be 2 units or 4 units. Since 2 units is not in the option, the correct answer will be 4 units.

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

⇒ 1 / 4 = (8 / DF)²

⇒ √(1 / 4) = 8 / DF

⇒ 1 / 2 = 8 / DF

⇒ 1 × DF = 8 × 2

⇒ DF = 16 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 16 cm.**

questions.question: In how many years will a sum of ₹4,250 yield a simple interest of ₹510 at a rate of 6% per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,250

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹510

Rate (R) = 6% per annum

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T) / 100

Where, T = Time in years

**Calculations:**

510 = (4250 × 6 × T) / 100

⇒ 510 = 255 × T

⇒ T = 510 / 255

⇒ T = 2 years

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold an article at a 26% profit. On selling it for ₹2,250 more, he would get a profit of 41%. If this article is sold at 12% profit, then the selling price would be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper sold an article at a 26% profit. On selling it for ₹2,250 more, he would get a profit of 41%. If this article is sold at 12% profit, then the selling price would be:

**Formula used:**

Let the cost price (CP) be ₹x.

Selling Price (SP) at 26% profit = x + 0.26x = 1.26x

Selling Price (SP) at 41% profit = x + 0.41x = 1.41x

**Calculation:**

Given: 1.41x - 1.26x = ₹2,250

⇒ 0.15x = ₹2,250

⇒ x = ₹2,250 / 0.15

⇒ x = ₹15,000

Selling Price at 12% profit = x + 0.12x = 1.12x

⇒ Selling Price = 1.12 × ₹15,000

⇒ Selling Price = ₹16,800

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**

questions.question: Out of a class of 200 people, 50 people’s average marks is 40, and the remaining 150 people’s average is 60. Find the people’s weighted average.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **students** = 50 : 150 = 1 : 3.

Assume a base **average** of 40.

Net deviation from 40 = 3 × (60 − 40) = 3 × 20 = 60.

Distribute deviation among total **ratio parts** (1 + 3 = 4): 60 ÷ 4 = 15.

Weighted Average = 40 + 15 = 55.

**∴ The correct answer is 55.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f951cc3331f226f8513a6df38dc596d38d0510dd8bccabf32961c70a6ca71b2.png] 

**Given:**

Number of people in Group 1 (n₁) = 50, Average (A₁) = 40

Number of people in Group 2 (n₂) = 150, Average (A₂) = 60

**Formula:**

Weighted Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total marks of Group 1 = 50 × 40 = 2000

⇒ Total marks of Group 2 = 150 × 60 = 9000

⇒ Total combined marks = 2000 + 9000 = 11000

⇒ Total number of people = 50 + 150 = 200

⇒ Weighted Average = 11000 ÷ 200

⇒ Weighted Average = 55

**∴ The correct answer is 55.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

For multiple groups, the formula is ΣnᵢAᵢ ÷ Σnᵢ, where n is the number of items and A is the average of each group.

Alligation Rule

Ratio of quantities = (Higher Average − Weighted Average) : (Weighted Average − Lower Average). This is used to find the ratio of quantities when the average of each and the mixture is known.

Deviation Method

Weighted Average = Assumed Average + (Net Deviation ÷ Total Quantity). This simplifies calculations by using smaller numbers.</p

Study the given bar-graph and answer the question that follows.

The bar-graph shows the production of refrigerators (in thousand) by five different companies A, B, C, D and E during 2004 to 2007.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55fbf3e2070b4e5a89b65689c0a9889d71ee34abd9f181821efeaffaa6829b1a.png] 

What is the difference between 60% of the average production of refrigerators by all the companies for the year 2005-2006 and 70% of the average of all the companies in 2006-2007?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Production of refrigerators (in thousand) by five different companies A, B, C, D, E in 2005-2006 and 2006-2007

2005-2006: A = 250, B = 340, C = 370, D = 490, E = 430

2006-2007: A = 390, B = 200, C = 450, D = 240, E = 360

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of values / Number of values

Required difference = 60% of 2005-2006 average - 70% of 2006-2007 average

**Calculation:**

Average of 2005-2006 = (250 + 340 + 370 + 490 + 430)/5

⇒ = 1880/5 = 376

60% of 376 = 0.6 * 376

⇒ = 225.6

Average of 2006-2007 = (390 + 200 + 450 + 240 + 360)/5

⇒ = 1640/5 = 328

70% of 328 = 0.7 * 328

⇒ = 229.6

Difference = 225.6 - 229.6

⇒ = 4 i.e. 4 thousand

**∴ The correct answer is 4000.**

questions.question: Teena does half of a task in 6 days. Later, with Shyam’s help, she completes the remaining work in 4 days. Shyam alone can finish the entire work in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Teena does half of a task in 6 
days.

With Shyam's help, she completes the remaining work in 4 days.

**Formula used:**

Work done by Teena in 6 days = 1/2 of the task.

Work done by Teena in 1 day = 1/12 of the task.

Let Shyam's 1 day work be 1/x of the task.

Combined work done by Teena and Shyam in 4 days = 1/2 of the task.

**Calculation:**

Teena's 1 day work = 1/12

Teena and Shyam's combined 1 day work = 1/4

⇒ 4(Teena's 1 day work + Shyam's 1 day work) = 1/2

⇒ 4(1/12 + 1/x) = 1/2

⇒ 1/12 + 1/x = 1/8

⇒ 1/x = 1/8 - 1/12

⇒ 1/x = (3 - 2)/24

⇒ 1/x = 1/24

⇒ x = 24

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of a father and son is 50 years. If after 5 years, the father’s age will be 5 times the age of the son, then what was the father’s age 5 years ago?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of ages of father and son after 5 years = 50 + 5 + 5 = 60 years.

Given ratio of Father to Son after 5 years = 5 : 1.

Father's age after 5 years = (5 ÷ 6) × 60 = 50 years.

Father's age 5 years ago (which is 10 years before the 'after 5 years' stage) = 50 − 10 = 40 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of present ages of father and son = 50 years.

After 5 years, the father's age will be 5 times the son's age.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aea9906a9385a78fd66497c52d8637a25f96cb57d03ab683b6f921cfd3d7a49c.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the present age of the father be x and the son be y.

⇒ x + y = 50 --- (Equation 1)

After 5 years, their ages will be (x + 5) and (y + 5).

According to the given condition:

⇒ x + 5 = 5 × (y + 5)

⇒ x + 5 = 5y + 25

⇒ x − 5y = 20 --- (Equation 2)

Subtracting Equation 2 from Equation 1:

⇒ (x + y) − (x − 5y) = 50 − 20

⇒ 6y = 30

⇒ y = 5

Substitute y = 5 in Equation 1:

⇒ x + 5 = 50

⇒ x = 45

The present age of the father is 45 years.

Father's age 5 years ago = 45 − 5 = 40 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Ages in Future/Past

If the sum of present ages of n people is S, then the sum of their ages after t years will be S + n × t, and t years ago it was S − n × t.

Age Difference

The difference in ages between any two people remains constant throughout their entire lives regardless of the time period.

Base Variables Setup

Always set the present age as the base variables (like x and y). This minimizes calculation errors when adjusting conditions for past or future ages.

questions.question: If the speed of a boat in still water is 3 km/h and if its speed upstream is 1 km/h, find the speed of the stream.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Speed of stream** = **Still water speed** − **Upstream speed**

Speed of stream = 3 km/h − 1 km/h

Speed of stream = 2 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 2 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of boat in **still water** (u) = 3 km/h

Speed of boat **upstream** (vᵤ) = 1 km/h

**Formula used:**

**Upstream speed** (vᵤ) = **Still water speed** (u) − **Stream speed** (v)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a66e290651b50ddfaa38efb20da7b777601fbba0f12c34dc35eae42174db80.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Upstream speed = Still water speed − Stream speed

⇒ 1 km/h = 3 km/h − Stream speed

⇒ Stream speed = 3 km/h − 1 km/h

⇒ Stream speed = 2 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 2 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Downstream Speed

It is the net speed of a boat moving with the flow of the stream. **Downstream Speed = Speed in still water + Speed of stream.**

Speed in Still Water

The actual speed of the boat without any stream influence. **Still Water Speed = (Downstream speed + Upstream speed) ÷ 2.**

Speed of the Stream

The speed at which the water is flowing. **Stream Speed = (Downstream speed − Upstream speed) ÷ 2.**</p
